_label: Sixth Lord-I-Call sticheron of the Holy Fathers (Great Vespers)

commemoration.title: Commemoration of the Holy Fathers of the Seventh Ecumenical Council

_note: Six slots, five distinct stichera. The OCA text fills the gap by repeating the first ('(Repeat: "The seven honorable councils…")'), so slot 2 is a byte-identical duplicate of slot 1 — which is exactly why this target is addressed by ORDER and only guarded by `expect`. A content-addressed override would have replaced both copies.

variants.label: OCA order — repeat the first sticheron

_provenance.source_citation: reference/scrape/2026-10-11.docx — '(Repeat: "The seven honorable councils…")' at V.(5)

value.text:
The seven honorable councils of the Fathers, held at various times,
were brought together under one canon in good order
by Patriarch Germanus the New.
He established and recorded their teachings;
he also presented these Fathers to the Lord
as watchful intercessors for our salvation,//
and as fellow-shepherds of the fold.

variants.label: A distinct sixth ("You expelled the vicious heretics…")

_provenance.source_citation: docs/choir-packets/2026-10-07/pdf/great-vespers-2026-10-10.pdf p.4, 'Lord I Have Cried (continued) / Tone 6 (Same Tone)', footer 'Sunday of the Holy Fathers (October 7-11) 2 / Vespers'. Read visually from the scan. Singer's syllable hyphens removed ('de-vour-ing', 'wick-èd').

value.text:
You expelled the vicious heretics from the Savior's fold,
those devouring wolves clothed in the skins of lambs:
Truly, you have done well, faithful shepherds, in exposing the wicked ones://
Therefore we all glorify you!
